The main takeaway from our work is that

Hendra virus infection in pteropodids is not periodic or synchronized across sites, but is driven by a range of local factors, including bat density, precipitation, temperature and possibly other factors.
Hendra virus infection in bats is not driven solely by seasonality, but is also affected by local environmental and population conditions.
Hendra virus dynamics in bat populations is complex and likely influenced by a range of environmental and ecological drivers.
